text: A muscular male figure with fair skin, appearing adult. Long blonde hair in a thick braid over his right shoulder. Square jaw, intense gaze. Bare-chested; wears reddish-brown arm bracers and a loincloth-like garment. Holds a dagger in right hand, blade pointing down. Kneels or crouches low, body angled forward. Background: dark teal cave with greenish rock formations. No other figures visible.
